CO17-1 A antigen is a protein of 26 kDa with at least two N- linked glycosylation sites.
CO17-1 A defines a protein that is a 26 kD polypeptide that has at least two glycosylation sites.

the identification of a new cell surface antigen expressed by a variety of carcinomas and its characterization as a 30 kDa glycoprotein.
the identification and characterization of a novel cell surface glycoprotein that may play a role in the development and progression of human adenocarcinomas of the colon.
the characterization of the CO-17-1A cell-surface antigen and the purification and sequencing of this antigen.

the CO17 antigen is a 30 kDa polypeptide, which is sensitive to proteinases, but is resistant to neuraminidases.

CO17-1 antigen is a 26 kD glycoprotein, which has a molecular weight of 30 kD and 40 kD in SDS-PAGE.
